_about: Five-star Google reviews for the home page (partials/reviews.njk), from the text Bowen saved on 2026-10-10 (Downloads/reviewsPRA.txt). Each review stays in the language it was written in; the English home shows the English ones, the Vietnamese home shows the Vietnamese ones first. Where a reviewer called PRA a school (or trường), the word is replaced in [square brackets], the usual mark for a changed word in a quote; cut passages are marked with an ellipsis. Never put a child's diagnosis on the site (Dagiimaa's review is trimmed for that). Names are first name plus last initial. Update `rating` and `count` from the Google listing now and then.

items.name: Benny M.
paras: We spent one month at this [academy], and it was truly an exceptional experience for our entire family.
This is a place that genuinely knows how to welcome children from all over the world with patience, sensitivity, and deep understanding of each child’s needs.

Our youngest son (almost 4) has always found it difficult to adjust to frameworks. This was the first time in his life that he went to kindergarten happily and willingly — every single day. That alone says everything.

Our oldest son learned more here than he did in school back in Israel. He enjoyed it so much that he actually asked us to stay an extra week in the city just because of the [academy]. And we did — purely because of how happy the kids were.
Our middle son was joyful and comfortable from the very first day.
This place is truly special — unlike any [place] we’ve experienced before.
We are deeply grateful for the care, professionalism, and warm atmosphere you create for children and families from around the world.
Highly recommended

items.name: Анастасия Ф.
paras: We are so happy [our son Lucas, then 3,] attended Palm River! The teachers are amazing, very attentive and kind. Ms. Tan was our teacher, and even six months later, my son still remembers her with a smile and misses her! We also made many new friends, and Lucas learned new skills. It's especially interesting that he spoke English from scratch in just 2 weeks! We also really enjoyed the physical education classes; our son almost learned to swim, and his physical development was noticeable every day! The classes are well-designed, and overall, the atmosphere is very friendly, with wonderful people working and studying here! We were very sad to leave after 3 months, and I really hope we'll come back again ❤️☀️

items.name: Alison B.
paras: My daughter has been attending Palm River for the past 6 years. We have been and continue to be extremely happy with her education… The class sizes are small, ensuring that the needs of each student are met and not missed. The quality of teachers is excellent; my daughter has loved all her teachers, which is super important to us. As a parent, I've always felt listened to and supported and truly appreciate that.

Having lived in HoiAn for nearly 10 years, I have had the good fortune to watch as schools developed (or closed), to speak with other parents about their experiences, and to really make a solid decision on what I felt was and is best for my daughter. For our family, Palm River Academy has been an excellent experience.

items.name: Jimmy R.
paras: A huge thank you to the entire Palm River Academy team for their warm welcome and kindness. We were touched by the team's caring, professionalism, and welcoming atmosphere.

Our son, who was the youngest at the academy, experienced incredible growth in a very short time. Although the adjustment was a little difficult at first, he quickly felt so comfortable at Palm River Academy that he dragged his feet when we came to pick him up… haha! 😊 It was a real joy to see him blossom, gain confidence, and progress so quickly.

He learned a tremendous amount and became much more independent over the months. He particularly loved the activities offered, especially the cooking classes and swimming sessions, which he always looked forward to. We also appreciated the quality of the meals: he ate very well and happily discovered new habits.
We were also very touched by the kindness and caring of the other children, who welcomed him with great gentleness and attention. This made all the difference for him and for us.

items.name: Mor A.
paras: Palm River Academy was such a special experience for our family during our time in Hoi An. We were initially drawn to the warm, community-oriented atmosphere and the balance between learning, creativity, and emotional support for the children.

Our children joined the International Program for traveling families during a short-term stay. Our older child was in Year 1 and our younger child was in the senior kindergarten group. The most meaningful thing for us was how quickly they both felt safe, confident, and genuinely happy to go to [the academy] every day. Their English improved naturally, but even more importantly, they felt seen, encouraged, and cared for by the teachers and staff.

What stood out most to us was the kindness and dedication of the team. As a traveling family joining for a relatively short period, we were amazed by how welcomed and included we felt from the very beginning.
We would absolutely recommend Palm River Academy to other families looking for a nurturing, positive, and engaging environment for their children.

items.name: Maayan R.
paras: We came for a short-term, without knowing much. And I’m so grateful for the amazing experience my 2 teenager boys had!!
They found enthusiastic teachers that just want to teach in an engaging, experiential way. They found new local friends! (Went to hang out together after [class])!
The [academy] staff was [warm] and welcoming, flexible and attentive!! We felt in good hands.
My boys (and I…) loved the [academy]!
We only came here for a short visit from our home country, but, if it were up to me, I’d come back here in a heartbeat! What a place!
Thank you for everything 🩵

items.name: Moshe B.
paras: Our children spent about a month and a half at Palm River Academy, and it was a wonderful experience. As a traveling family, we were looking for a supportive environment where our children could enjoy time with other kids while also continuing their learning.

We were immediately drawn to the warm atmosphere and strong sense of community. Even in that short time, we saw our children become more confident and excited about learning. The teachers were caring and supportive, and our children felt very comfortable there.
We are very grateful for the time our family spent at Palm River Academy and would warmly recommend it to other families.

items.name: Ngoc N.
paras: As someone working in the education field, I really value what Palm River Academy team is doing.
The teachers genuinely care and are skilled in how they guide the children. You can feel the intention behind how they support each child’s learning and emotions.
What stands out to me is that it’s more than just [an academy]. It’s a community where diversity is embraced, and children learn to feel included and confident.
If you’re looking for a place that focuses on your child’s growth and sense of belonging—rather than flashy facilities—I would definitely recommend Palm River Academy

items.name: Dagiimaa B.
paras: We spent 30 days traveling across Vietnam—the maximum duration for our visa—and as a traveling and working mom, I needed some support for my children during this time. A former colleague from Mongolia recommended Palm River Academy, and since we had similar experiences raising children, I trusted her and decided to apply.

I was nervous at first… But from the very first day, both my girls adjusted beautifully. My older daughter, who used to complain about going to school, now never wants to leave when classes end—she’s made wonderful friends and truly enjoys learning. My younger one quickly adapted to her teachers and the academy environment, and she even naps during rest time, which is a new and welcome change for us!
At the end of their time there, both girls received certificates—treasures we keep proudly at home as symbols of their happiness and growth.
… And if you’re a traveling, working parent, this academy can offer your children joyful, engaging days while you focus on your work with peace of mind.

items.name: Brandy V.
paras: Tôi hài lòng với Palm River Academy đã tạo môi trường dạy dỗ quy củ, chương trình học được thiết kế bài bản, vừa thách thức vừa hỗ trợ con tôi một cách ý nghĩa. Thầy cô tận tình, nhìn cách họ chăm sóc và dạy dỗ là biết họ thật sự yêu nghề…

items.name: Chi T.
paras: Đây là một [trung tâm] tuyệt vời. Các con của chúng tôi đã có khoảng thời gian thật hạnh phú[c] và tràn ngập tiếng cười. Các bạn hoà mình vào thiên nhiên và học hỏi mọi thứ xung quanh mình. Tại đây, các Thầy Cô rất tận tâm và các bạn được dạy dỗ cách ứng xử rất tốt với mọi người xung quanh mình. Môi trường tiếp xúc tiếng Anh hoàn toàn giúp các bạn khá tự tin giao tiếp với người nước ngoài. Tôi rất yên tâm khi cho con học tại đây

items.name: Tram T.
paras: Tôi rất vui và yên tâm khi con theo học [trung tâm] Palm. Các thầy cô ở đây tận tuỵ và rất quan tâm đến con. Thầy cô hiểu được từng chi tiết nhỏ trong tính cách của con. Cảm ơn thầy cô ! Cảm ơn [trung tâm] Palm rất nhiều ❤️

items.name: Zhou L.
paras: Các con chúng tôi đã có những trải nghiệm thú vị và bổ ích khi học tại Palm. Các hoạt động tại Palm giúp con có nhiều kiến thức bổ ích, các con học được cách yêu thương và chia sẻ. Bên cạnh đó việc học trong môi trường hoàn toàn bằng tiếng Anh giúp con tự tin khi giao tiếp với người nước ngoài

items.name: Tân N.
paras: Palm là một nơi lý tưởng để làm nền tản cho con cái học tập và rèn luyện. Các thầy cô luôn nhiệt tình chào đón và chia sẽ kiến thức bằng các trãi nghiệm thực tế giúp các con nắm bắt nhanh hơn, hiệu quả hơn trong quá trình học tập. Tôi luôn tin tưởng và ủng hộ. Chúc Palm vươn cao và mang lại nhiều thành tựu trong năm học sắp đến!
